clips.description: the musket reload, unchanged (the bayonet stays fixed: the blade runs under the muzzle, left of the ramrod)

a short thrust: drawn back (wind-up), driven forward along the barrel to full extension (StabHit at the point of impact, socket_bayonet_tip), held a beat, recovered to the hip; TP: the torso leans into it
charge bayonet: the musket lowered to the hip, bayonet forward, a running stride, then a lunge (ChargeHit at full extension), recovered; TP full body (legs run then lunge; the game keeps its legs)

moving_parts.bayonet: rigid on root in every clip (fixed bayonet); HideBoneByName("bayonet") hides the socket, neck and blade

bayonet.note: blade under the muzzle, 2 cm to the left of the bore (clear of the ramrod channel)

assets.role: FP arms (FPArm parts on the bean skeleton)
the musket with its fixed bayonet lying on the ground (pickup)
the musket with its fixed bayonet lying on the ground (pickup)

SM_Bean_BayonetMusket.role: the musket with its fixed bayonet lying on the ground (pickup)

rules.Melee: BayonetStab: damage at StabHit along socket_bayonet_tip; BayonetCharge: damage at ChargeHit
rules.Aliases: AimFire -> Fire (the musket family has no AimFire clip)

notes: The pirate musket of scripts/props/musket_pack (v0.4.0-local-v2) with a socket bayonet: every musket clip is rebuilt by the musket's own animation module (same choreography, lengths and events), the weapon skeleton gains the bone "bayonet" and socket_bayonet_tip.
New gestures BayonetStab (15 frames, StabHit 7) and BayonetCharge (24 frames, ChargeHit 16), 24 fps like the musket; EFirearmGesture::BayonetStab / BayonetCharge to add.

coordinate_system.blender: +X weapon forward, +Z up, -Y right side; the bean looks along -Y, its right side is -X
coordinate_system.unreal: convert_scene + convert_scene_unit, import scale 1; a weapon point (x, y, z) m -> (x, -y, z) * 100 cm

Idle.gesture: Idle (hip, frame 0 = base pose, every non reload clip)

AimIdle.gesture: AimIdle / AimIn / AimOut / Fire aimed (game aim framing, not an authored pose)

fp_framing.note: HipGripLocation / HipRotation reproduce this camera exactly (Idle frame 0 = FP base pose). AimMuzzleLocation / AimRotation (aim_*) put the sight line (rear notch -> front sight, parallel to the bore, height_above_bore_m above it) exactly on the camera axis, weapon centred, with the muzzle socket AIM_MUZZLE_CM ahead: AimIdle keeps the base pose (the game aligns Idle and AimIdle frame 0), so the single Fire clip plays aimed without a jump. setup_pirate_weapons.py writes the hip values only: copy aim_* into DA_PirateMusketRules by hand (AimMuzzleLocation, AimRotation).
fp_framing.bayonet_note: bayonet point in the view (cm) at StabHit / ChargeHit with the pack camera (hip framing of the game = this camera)

M_BayonetMusket_Wood.orm_channels: R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metallic (linear)

unreal_import.actor_attachment: Both Bean and weapon actor roots use the same world transform; do not attach the weapon to the hand a second time.
unreal_import.textures: manifest.materials[M_*].textures by label: BaseColor (sRGB), Normal (DirectX, green down), ORM (AO / roughness / metallic, linear); a material without textures (lenses) keeps the material of the FBX import
unreal_import.statics: exports/Static/*.fbx: pivot bottom centre, UCX hulls in the file (import with collision from the file)
